title: Saving a plan, gym details or a workout plan can fail with no note kept of why
what: When saving a membership plan, the starter price list, the gym's details, a workout plan, sending a workout plan to a member, withdrawing a plan, or Start fresh / Load demo fails, the screen shows the error words but keeps no note of the real reason anywhere, not even in the browser's own log. Other screens in this area at least write the reason to the browser log.
expected: Every failed save keeps a note of the real reason, so support can find out why it failed.
how_often: each time one of these saves fails
fix_line: Write the real reason to the log in each of these failure paths, as the other screens do

title: When an owner cannot report paying MettleUp, book a trainer session, reply to a member or save the web page, MettleUp never hears of it
what: These screens catch every failure, show the owner a message and write the reason only to the hidden browser log on that one computer. The crash reporter only catches errors nobody handled, so none of these reach MettleUp. An owner whose payment report keeps failing, or whose replies to members never go, is only found when the gym complains or stops paying.
expected: A failed payment report, booking, reply or page save is counted and reported to MettleUp, with a daily count, so we know before the gym tells us.
fix_line: Send caught failures on these money and member screens to the same crash report service, with a daily count

title: On a slow line, a reply to a member's message can reach the member twice
what: If the owner's reply to a member's message is saved but the answer is lost on the way back, the screen says it failed. The owner presses Send again, and the server saves the same reply a second time and sends the member a second pop-up. Nothing marks the two presses as one reply. Answering an Ask-a-trainer question is safe: the server refuses a second answer.
expected: Pressing Send again after a lost answer never saves the same reply twice.
how_often: rare, on a slow or dropping line
fix_line: Give each reply a one-time id that the server checks, as personal-training booking already does

title: The restore of a real nightly backup copy was never written down as done
what: Nightly backups are live and the build machine restores a test copy on every push. The restore steps say to restore a real nightly copy on the test server once after switching on and again mid-pilot, and to write down the result. No such result is written in the progress notes, so a restore of real gym data has never been proven.
expected: A dated record that a real nightly copy was restored on the test server and its totals matched.
how_often: only matters on a data loss
fix_line: Run the restore steps once on the test server and write the date and totals down

items.reason: Only timer here is the trainer week's minute clock, which re-reads the real time each tick, so a sleeping tab catches up; heart rate, watch and workout clock are not on this web page.
